summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests AVZO-103, a Nectin4/Trop2 ADC (antibody-drug conjugate), alone and in combination, in adults with locally advanced or metastatic urothelial cancer or other solid tumors. AVZO-103 is given intravenously, and combination agents are given per their label, with dose and schedule set by the protocol; duration is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, maximum tolerated dose, and antitumor activity.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa AVZO-103, un ADC (conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco) dirigido a Nectin4/Trop2, solo y en combinación, en adultos con cáncer urotelial localmente avanzado o metastásico u otros tumores sólidos. AVZO-103 se administra por vía intravenosa, y los agentes de combinación se administran según su prospecto, con dosis y esquema definidos por el protocolo; la duración no se indica. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerancia, la farmacocinética, la farmacodinamia, la dosis máxima tolerada y la actividad antitumoral.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with ECOG performance status of 1 or less
Confirmed locally advanced or metastatic urothelial cancer or other specified solid tumors
Agrees to provide molecular test results and tumor samples
not_for: Active brain metastases, unless treated, radiologically stable 4+ weeks, and not on steroids
Suspected or confirmed leptomeningeal disease, even if treated
Prior Stevens-Johnson syndrome or toxic epidermal necrolysis
History of drug-induced interstitial lung disease
History of any serious cardiovascular condition, or infection needing IV antibiotics, antivirals or antifungals within 2 weeks before first dose
